evidence_excerpts: Simulations of the rule 110-124 circuit using the previously developed model for purified seesaw circuits predicted desired outputs in roughly 8 h and undesired reactions taking over in 24 h, while simulations using the new model for unpurified seesaw circuits predicted desired outputs in roughly 24 h.
text: A model that represents synthesis errors in unpurified molecules predicts the slower 24-hour behavior of the rule 110-124 circuit better than the purified-circuit model.
